name: River spirit
description: A river spirit Azami took for a great kami; it made a pact with her and was later found to have no great powers.

description_citations.text: "Azami Ozu". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: As a child, Azami made a pact with a river spirit to give everything in pursuit of knowledge.
timeline.quote: The kami made a pact with Azami who said she would give everything in the pursuit of knowledge.

citation.text: "Azami Ozu", section "Youth". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Azami studied the captured river spirit and realized it had no great powers.
timeline.quote: She studied the creature and came to realize that it had no great powers.

citation.text: "Azami Ozu", section "The Kami's Will". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
